components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The leading action on a working surface, with a phone-safe touch floor.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: var(--primary, #2244cc); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 500 12px/1.625 var(--brand-font-sans, sans-serif); transition: background-color 100ms var(--brand-ease-cozy, cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1)), opacity 100ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-ultramarine-dark, #16308f); } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: .9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #2244cc); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-btn-primary { min-width: 40px; min-height: 40px; } }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A supporting action on a ruled paper surface, with a phone-safe touch floor.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d8d2c4); border-radius: 0; background: var(--card, #fcfaf4); color: var(--foreground, #16170f); font: 500 12px/1.625 var(--brand-font-sans, sans-serif); transition: background-color 100ms var(--brand-ease-cozy, cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1)); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #efeae0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #2244cc); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-btn-outline { min-width: 40px; min-height: 40px; } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A compact desktop field that grows to a phone-safe height responsively.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 28px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d8d2c4); border-radius: 0; background: rgb(239 234 224 / .2); color: var(--foreground, #16170f); font: 400 12px/1.625 var(--brand-font-sans, sans-serif); transition: border-color 100ms var(--brand-ease-cozy, cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1)); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #6b6658); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(34 68 204 / .3); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--ring, #2244cc); } @media (max-width: 639px) { .ds-input { height: 40px; font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Primary Badge
components.description: A square categorical stamp with a quiet semantic tint.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; height: 20px; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid rgb(34 68 204 / .4); border-radius: 0; background: rgb(34 68 204 / .1); color: var(--primary, #2244cc); font: 500 10px/14px var(--brand-font-mono, monospace); letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge:hover { background: rgb(34 68 204 / .2); } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #2244cc); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ruled Card
components.description: A genuinely bounded ledger region, never a floating repeated row.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--border, #d8d2c4); border-radius: 0; background: var(--card, #fcfaf4); color: var(--card-foreground, #16170f); padding: 10px 14px; } .ds-card-label { margin: 0 0 6px; color: var(--slate, #6b6658); font: 500 10px/14px var(--brand-font-mono, monospace); letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-value { margin: 0; font: 600 16px/24px var(--brand-font-mono, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card:focus-within { border-color: var(--ring, #2244cc); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: A bordered paper state for a task-first workspace destination or grouped domain trigger.
components.html: Projects
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d8d2c4); border-radius: 0; background: var(--background, #f7f4ec); color: var(--foreground, #16170f); font: 500 12px/1.625 var(--brand-font-sans, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 100ms var(--brand-ease-cozy, cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1)); } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: var(--muted, #efeae0); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #2244cc); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ledger Table Header
components.description: The printed-control-sheet header band used above dense records.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--foreground, #16170f); font: 400 12px/16px var(--brand-font-sans, sans-serif); } .ds-table thead { background: var(--card, #fcfaf4); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--foreground, #16170f); } .ds-table th { height: 40px; padding: 0 8px; color: var(--slate, #6b6658); font: 600 10px/14px var(--brand-font-mono, monospace); letter-spacing: .05em; text-align: left; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-table td { padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #d8d2c4); } .ds-table tr:hover td { background: rgb(239 234 224 / .5); } .ds-table:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #2244cc); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Cubby should feel like a working household record carried between pantry, workshop, and desk. It applies print-editorial discipline to a data-dense operating tool: matte paper, crisp ink, compact typography, ruled regions, and information arranged to be scanned while someone is doing real work. The result is practical, exacting, and lived-in rather than polished for a sales demo.

Components are flat, ruled, and instrument-like. Hierarchy comes from typography, paper tone, hairline division, and a small number of heavy ink rules—not from floating cards or theatrical whitespace. Dense screens should resemble control sheets, catalogs, and ledgers whose structure becomes clearer as information accumulates.

The visual anti-reference is the glossy SaaS dashboard: no glass, glow, gradient-filled surfaces, dark control-room canvas, soft lifestyle sentimentality, or generic enterprise card stacks. Cubby remains warm without becoming decorative, and technical without becoming sterile.
keyCharacteristics: Warm matte paper surfaces with near-black ink.
High information density and compact, repeatable rhythm.
Square geometry, hairline borders, and signature 3px ink rules.
One loud interactive ultramarine used with restraint.
Space Grotesk headings, Inter prose, and JetBrains Mono data.
Flat charts and tables that favor comparison over spectacle.

rules.name: The One Loud Thing Rule
rules.body: Live Ultramarine is the loudest color on the screen and should identify an action, active state, focus, or one live value—not decorate every panel.

rules.name: The Paper, Not Glass Rule
rules.body: Separate with paper tone and ink rules. Do not introduce glow, translucent glass, surface gradients, or chromatic shadows.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk names, Inter explains, and JetBrains Mono measures. Do not use the mono face as a novelty display font or the heading face for dense data.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Construction Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs separation, add a real rule or change its paper tone. Never reach for a drop shadow to repair weak hierarchy.

dos: Do use paper tone, Hairline borders, and 3px Ink rules to establish hierarchy.
Do reserve Live Ultramarine for action, focus, selection, active navigation, and one important live value.
Do use Space Grotesk for names, Inter for explanation, and JetBrains Mono for measurements and codes.
Do build dense repeated information as aligned rows, tables, or matrices.
Do use the named layout primitives and closed spacing rhythm for repeated structures.
Do preserve 40–48px phone controls and safe-area-aware fixed chrome.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, glass blur, glow, surface gradients, dark dashboard chrome, or neon accents.
Don't turn repeated records into stacks of airy padded cards.
Don't round ordinary controls, panels, navigation states, badges, or dialogs.
Don't use Live Ultramarine as general decoration or introduce competing arbitrary blue shades.
Don't invent a fourth text hierarchy tier with opacity; use Ink, Shelf Ink, or Slate Mark.
Don't use raw red, green, amber, or yellow utilities when the semantic Positive, Warning, or Destructive tokens express the meaning.
Don't shrink phone controls to desktop density or disable pinch zoom.
